summary: ClyoCloud is a self-hosted application designed for personal cloud storage and media management. It provides a web-based interface to handle file transfers and stream video content while keeping your data private. Released under the AGPL-3.0 licence, the project is built using Node.js.
goodFor: It suits individuals wanting a dedicated, self-hosted web interface specifically tailored for managing personal files and media libraries under an open-source licence.
watchOut: The repository currently has zero recorded commits in recent months and no tagged releases, indicating an early-stage or inactive project with virtually no community adoption yet.
deployNotes: Because it runs on Node.js, you will typically need to run it behind a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination and configure persistent storage volumes on your server to retain uploaded files.
